_comment: Hierarchical LP AllGather on mini_2gpu_2nic. 4 hosts x 2 GPUs, each GPU owns its own 100Gbps NIC (2 uplinks per host), 2 leaves / 2 spines. The only mini variant that can run hierarchically: mini_1gpu_1nic has no host tier to fold, and mini_2gpu_1nic's shared NIC hangs off the PCIe root complex, which cannot be a cell (see its .topo). LP-hierarchical twin of the MILP inputs for A/B: identical except formulation=2 and the LP's milp_chunking is unused. SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs, no cut-through optimism). switch_copy is honored at MILP levels: a switch fan-out is one send, charged once to its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid (see teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md). Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md.
